456:t_027:17.en:
$$ミコノ$$
($$アポロ$$... he's looking this way...)

456:t_028:0.en:
$$レズン$$
「Damn it...! If we keep doing this, $$ジオン$$ will just wither away!」

456:t_028:2.en:
$$レズン$$
「Shut up! What can you possibly do now, you who chased your own ideals and abandoned $$ジオン$$!」

456:t_028:3.en:
$$レズン$$
「Neither $$ギュネイ$$ nor I will forgive you! Don't you forget it!」

456:t_029:2.en:
$$シャア$$
「I was prepared for this. Don't worry, $$カミーユ$$.」

456:t_029:4.en:
$$シャア$$
「I know. Even if I've cast off the name of the $$赤い彗星$$, saving them is my duty.」

456:t_100:0.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Earth is great! Getting to fight monsters like these is the best!」

456:t_100:1.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「A Wingless with no manners. No wonder, when they don't even notice their own sin.」

456:t_100:2.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「I'm used to being talked to like I'm not even a person. Not that it's much fun.」

456:t_100:4.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「No one can stop me...! I am the $$欲深な金牛$$, $$エルーナルーナ・バーンストラウス$$!」

456:t_100:5.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「I'm the leader of $$ハイアデス$$, the strongest fighting group in the galaxy! You're fighting me now, $$堕天翅$$!」

456:t_100:6.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Heh heh... you lot... may turn out to be more useful than I thought.」

456:t_101:0.en:
$$アマタ$$
「$$ミカゲ$$! Today I'm finally stopping you!」

456:t_101:1.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Then shall I stop your breath for good, instead?」

456:t_101:2.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「No... it would be boring to kill you both. I'll let just one of you live.」

456:t_101:4.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Having your life taken, or living out the time that remains alone... I'll let you decide for yourselves which to choose.」

456:t_101:6.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「We won't be swallowed by your hatred...!」

456:t_101:8.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Enough chatter. It's time I drew the curtain on your lives.」

456:t_102:0.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Two women and one man... The roots I have steadily spread are sprouting, blooming, and about to bear fruit.」

456:t_102:1.en:
$$アルト$$
「Your ambition ends here, $$ミカゲ$$! For $$シェリル$$ and the others, I'm taking you down right here!」

456:t_102:2.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「That single-minded devotion gives me strength...」

456:t_103:0.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Hi, Darling! Have you been well!?」

456:t_103:1.en:
$$ランド$$
「I finally get why you wear me out so much. You... your vibe is just like $$メール$$'s.」

456:t_103:2.en:
$$メール$$
「What is that supposed to mean!?」

456:t_103:3.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Then maybe I could get along with that girl too!」

456:t_103:5.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Okay, got it! I'll look after her as well, so come to $$ハイアデス$$, the two of you!」

456:t_103:7.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Looking after two people is easy for someone with the capacity of $$エルーナルーナ$$! So come along without worrying!」

456:t_103:8.en:
$$ランド$$
「You're just as unprincipled, living on impulse like that! Don't think you can get through life on that alone!」

456:t_104:0.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「So that's the famous $$ジェミニオン・レイ$$! Not bad at all!」

456:t_104:1.en:
$n
「You can afford to praise the machine that's going to beat you?」

456:t_104:2.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「I can. You've been getting stronger, but from where I stand, you've still got a long way to go.」

456:t_104:3.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「I'll coach you right now! Then you'll get stronger and stronger!」

456:t_104:4.en:
$n
「No thanks! There's only one woman I want to call teacher!」

456:t_105:0.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Big game here! I'm taking it down!」

456:t_105:1.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「A real fight with the legendary Mechanical Angel! This looks like fun!」

456:t_105:2.en:
$$シリウス$$
「This woman...! She's a raging bull that doesn't know how to retreat!」

456:t_105:3.en:
$$アポロ$$
「I'm used to dealing with women like that, thanks to $$シルヴィア$$!」

456:t_105:4.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
「Hey, $$アポロ$$! Don't lump me in with that one!」

456:t_105:5.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Save the nagging for later! This one's got plenty to sink our teeth into!」

456:t_105:6.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Here I come, $$エルーナルーナ$$! I'll turn that prized machine of yours into steak and eat it!」

456:t_106:0.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Heh... $$アクエリオン$$... It's been 12,000 years.」

456:t_106:1.en:
$$シリウス$$
「I never thought I would fight alongside $$アクエリオン$$ again.」

456:t_106:2.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
「Oh, Big Brother. I always thought this day would come.」

456:t_106:3.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
「I believed that the day would come when I'd see $$アポロ$$ and you again, Big Brother.」

456:t_106:6.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
「Come on, $$アポロ$$! The enemy is right in front of us!」

456:t_106:7.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Yeah! With you fighting beside me, I don't feel like I can lose!」

456:t_106:8.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Here we go! The sun has risen again!!」

456:t_107:0.en:
$$レズン$$
「I'm making you settle up for what you did, Colonel $$シャア$$!」

456:t_107:1.en:
$$シャア$$
(If I can't take this on, I can never defeat $$フル・フロンタル$$ or $$ハマーン$$...!)

456:t_107:2.en:
$$シャア$$
(The Spacenoids' karma...! I'll pay for it in some way other than spewing out hatred!)
